analysis.title: GS - Pasquariello - markets macro - 28 Oct 2026
key_insights: GS flagship momentum basket has recorded 39 distinct 1-day moves greater than 5% in 2026 with two months left. Only 2020 (42) was higher since at least 1999. Other high counts were 32 in 2000 and 19 in 2009.
The momentum basket (GSPRHIMO) tripled from the launch of ChatGPT to the late June highs and has since sold off 40%. 27 of the 39 big moves this year were selloffs.
Navigation beneath the surface of the S&P 500 has been difficult, while the index itself is still going nowhere, within a whisker of 7700, supported by a steady supply of index gamma.
Retail trading volumes in US equities are down 20% since the summer and 45% since late 2025. GS's Speculative Trading Indicator has turned lower in recent months after surging in mid-2025.

GS attributes the retail pullback mostly to weak consumer sentiment and elevated energy prices. Prediction markets are a fast-growing alternative, with monthly volumes of $78 billion in September versus $5 billion a year ago.
Top-of-book liquidity in Russell 3000 stocks and S&P futures has not yet returned to pre-COVID levels (work credited to Jason Epstein).
The note points to Freddie Parker's hedge fund work and a chart sourced from GS FICC and Equities with data as of 20 Oct 2026. The chart content is not described in the text.
risk_factors: Violent momentum swings beneath a flat S&P 500 index, with selloffs dominating the large moves.
Thin top-of-book liquidity in Russell 3000 stocks and S&P futures relative to pre-COVID.
Weak consumer sentiment and elevated energy prices are weighing on retail participation.
